title.narrative: Emergency intervention to provide relief to the Gaza Strip in the water and sanitation sector

description.narrative: - Procurement and operation of five tankers for the distribution of potable water (each with a capacity of 10 cubic meters). - Transportation of 1,800 cubic meters of water daily to shelters and host communities using 36 water tankers. - Distribution of water storage containers, including 23,232 jerry cans and 19,800 buckets, to facilitate safe access to water. - Waste collection and transportation in southern Gaza (600 cubic meters/day) and northern Gaza (180 cubic meters/day) through private sector engagement. - Rehabilitation of temporary dumping sites and supervision of fuel distribution to support waste management services. - Deployment of workers to ensure proper waste removal and supervision of fuel use.
Providing safe drinking water to the most vulnerable groups and contributing to supporting essential environmental services

The project seeks to enable Palestinians in the Gaza Strip, especially the most affected and most vulnerable, to have access to dignified, inclusive, gender-sensitive and high-quality public services, as well as to enhance the solid waste management capacities of local municipal institutions and affected communities.
